arguments:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$exe = 'C:\Assets\Cinebench2026\Cinebench.exe'
'=== SIGNATURE ==='
$sig = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $exe
[pscustomobject]@{Status=$sig.Status;StatusMessage=$sig.StatusMessage;SignerSubject=$sig.SignerCertificate.Subject;SignerIssuer=$sig.SignerCertificate.Issuer;SignerThumbprint=$sig.SignerCertificate.Thumbprint;SignerNotBefore=$sig.SignerCertificate.NotBefore;SignerNotAfter=$sig.SignerCertificate.NotAfter;TimestampSubject=$sig.TimeStamperCertificate.Subject;TimestampIssuer=$sig.TimeStamperCertificate.Issuer} | Format-List
'=== CHAIN ==='
if ($sig.SignerCertificate) {
 $chain = New-Object System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Chain
 $ok = $chain.Build($sig.SignerCertificate)
 'CHAIN_OK=' + $ok
 $chain.ChainStatus | Select-Object Status,StatusInformation | Format-List
 $chain.ChainElements | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{Subject=$_.Certificate.Subject;Issuer=$_.Certificate.Issuer;Thumbprint=$_.Certificate.Thumbprint;NotAfter=$_.Certificate.NotAfter} } | Format-List
}
'=== DIGICERT_STORES ==='
$stores = @('Cert:\LocalMachine\Root','Cert:\LocalMachine\CA','Cert:\CurrentUser\Root','Cert:\CurrentUser\CA')
foreach ($store in $stores) {
 Write-Output ('STORE=' + $store)
 Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $store | Where-Object { $_.Subject -match 'DigiCert' -or $_.Issuer -match 'DigiCert' } | Select-Object Subject,Issuer,Thumbprint,NotBefore,NotAfter | Sort-Object Subject | Format-List
}
'=== SYSTEM_TIME ==='
Get-Date -Format o
exit 0
